review_text: Terribly bad. First they send me the wrong part with a manufacturing defect, then I have to wait 2 months for the right part which has not yet been sent out from them. I do not recommend anyone to shop at AUTODOC at all. VERY BAD SERVICE!!! ____________________________________________________________ Got a message from the workshop today that the new part you sent was also the wrong part. They spent 9 working hours trying to adapt it but it was not possible. 1/ You have received the original part number. 2/ You have received the registration number of the car. 3/ You have received the chassis number of the car. 4/ You have received pictures of the old part. You have managed to send me the wrong part for the second time. You are completely incompetent at Autodoc You must pay me compensation for the hours that have been spent at the workshop _________________________________________________________ Have now sent Autodoc a compensation claim for extra expenses that I incurred from the workshop. I agreed on a fixed price with the workshop of NOK 6,800 to replace the exhaust manifold. The bill from the workshop came to NOK 14,720 because Autodoc sent me a manifold with manufacturing defects twice. The additional cost for me is therefore NOK 7,920, which I believe Autodoc must compensate me for. I have now emailed them all the documentation from the workshop, just need to wait and see what they do with the case. WRITTEN FROM THE WORKSHOP: Complaint about additional costs – incorrect and incomplete parts delivered by Autodoc To: Autodoc From: Bilsenteret Namsos AS – on behalf of the customer Regarding: Incorrectly delivered/defective exhaust manifolds and resulting additional costs Reg. no.: ¤¤¤¤¤¤¤ We hereby wish to file a formal complaint about parts delivered by Autodoc, as incorrect and defective exhaust manifolds caused significant extra work and additional costs for the customer. Background of the case The customer ordered an exhaust manifold from Autodoc and delivered the parts to us for installation. The work was agreed to cost NOK 6,800 including VAT. During the work, we documented the following: Work process and deviations related to the parts 16.01.2026 Dismantling of the exhaust manifold Dismantling of the turbo Dismantling of the rear engine mount Dismantling of the exhaust system Dismantling of the plate under the engine Discovered that the first exhaust manifold delivered by Autodoc was incorrect, due to a deviation in the EGR connection (wrong widening on the stub) 17.02.2026 Installation of new exhaust manifold (second part delivered by Autodoc) Turbo could not be installed, as it interfered with the exhaust manifold Dismantling of exhaust manifold again Attempt to install turbo on manifold New attempt to install manifold with turbo Conclusion: Part no. 2 from Autodoc had incorrect dimensions / too thick material, and did not fit This resulted in the work having to be stopped and redone several times, without progress due to insufficient part quality. 23.02.2026 Installation of old exhaust manifold (welded and repaired by He-Plan) Installation of turbo Installation of engine mount Installation of exhaust system Installation of plate under engine Test drive – OK Customer provided own gaskets and mounting hardware Additional costs The customer initially received a price of NOK 6,800 including VAT for the job. Due to two unusable and incorrectly manufactured exhaust manifolds delivered by Autodoc, the customer ended up with: NOK 12,800 including VAT for labor NOK 1,920 including VAT for welding/repair of the old manifold Total additional cost: NOK 7,920 including VAT These are additional costs that would not have occurred if the parts from Autodoc had been correct and mountable. Our assessment Incorrect and incomplete parts caused: Unnecessary extra work Repeated disassembly and assembly without progress Extra costs for the customer Delay in vehicle repair All additional costs could have been avoided if the parts had the correct specification and fit. Claim On behalf of the customer, we request that Autodoc: Refunds the additional cost of NOK 7,920 including VAT Or alternatively, refunds the cost of the incorrectly delivered/incomplete parts Documentation and work descriptions are attached. Conclusion We ask for your feedback as soon as possible, as well as information on how this matter is further handled. We are happy to assist with additional documentation if necessary. Sincerely, Bilsenteret Namsos AS On behalf of the customer

review_text: I ordered a steering rack for my 2009 Audi A4 B8 2.0l TDI (143hp) 2 weeks ago. The delivery was fast, it arrived in only a few days, which i liked. I have tried to contact AUTODOC in multiple ways. -The AI assistant on their app told me I'd get an e-mail in 24-48 hours, 4 days later I haven't received anything. -I have called their numbers in hope of reaching an actual human instead of an AI, but guess what. I could repeat a sentence 3 times and he wouldn't understand a thing I said, so after some time he gave up and said "We're happy we could solve your problem!" Next I wanted to see if it's possible to atleast return the steering rack, but no, "Unfortunately, this product is not eligible for a refund." review_text: After posting this complaint, I was eventually contacted and reimbursed for the incompatible parts. However, after a few messages, the employee who had initially reached out to me appeared to stop responding, which forced me to contact the in-app support again. Only then was a warranty claim filed and my money refunded. While I am grateful for the resolution, I remain concerned about the way it was handled. The company referred to this outcome as a ‘gesture of goodwill.’ In reality, complying with consumer protection law is not goodwill—it is a legal obligation. What troubles me most is that, instead of straightforward assistance, I personally had to spend a great deal of time researching laws, studying specific legal articles, and presenting them to prove that I had the right to a refund. I appreciate the final resolution, but the process was unnecessarily time-consuming, frustrating, and placed the entire burden on me as the customer. Order number: 119912765 Order date: 10.09.2024 I am extremely disappointed with Autodoc’s customer service and their refusal to take responsibility for an incorrect part selection. All my previous orders for my Honda Accord 8 (VIN: JHMCU35809C203590) were always placed through Autodoc’s support team, never by myself. I always relied on their staff to provide the correct parts. However, in this case Autodoc now falsely claims that I ordered the parts on my own without their involvement, which is absolutely not true. The lower control arms that I received do not fit my vehicle. This is a clear case of “Sachmangel” under §434 BGB (German Civil Code) — the goods do not conform to the contract, as they are not suitable for the intended purpose. The courier didn’t ring the bell or ask for a signature, although the shop had explicitly written “delivery against signature”. review_text: Probably the worst online purchase experience I ever had! I bought a device at this shop through Rakuten. The order was confirmed rather quickly and a first DHL notification was received, (stating that a delivery request had been received and that as the shipping would start as soon as DHL receives the parcel). After some 2-3 days, the status remained unchanged. So I contacted the vendor, who explained he had a contact with DHL and learned that they have some operational issues and thus delay to scan/ship the parcels. It looked a bit strange, but since a letter from DHL was also attached, I trusted the information. After a week, the status was still unchanged, therefore I contacted DHL itself, explaining the whole situation and sending them the DHL letter (with no date, no name on it…)… DHL could only confirm that the parcel had simply not been given to them by the seller … Then I contacted the seller to confront him with this opposite information. A long chains of mails followed. The answers were very quick, but in summary, he could only repeat over and over again the same thing, ie I had to read again and better the information he had already given me and that he should not be hold responsible of DHL delay (which is false). I could also feel that answers were becoming more aggressive. I wanted to use my right to cancel the order within 14 days, according to the german laws, but that was rejected again (which goes against german laws). Based on DHL reaction and seller’s attitude, I escalated the situation to Paypal and Rakuten. Rakuten reacted very quickly and contacted the seller. I guess that by seeing some higher authorities were getting involved, then he finally decided to cancel the order, so I got reimbursed. However, I’m convinced that I would have received neither the device, nor the reimbursement if I had bought the device directly to this shop… I saw in some other reviews that the seller threatened some people having put a negative review about him of legal actions, so I guess that I will get a quick reaction too, let’s see… So much fuss and stress… I would recommend to anyone to avoid any risk and to buy in another shop… (which I do and got the device 2 days after…)

review_text: The shop looks good, there are a lot of items, and the prices seem to be reasonable. My inquiry was answered quickly, so my first impression was good. Therefore I felt confident when I bought a bundled naviceiver and some tool, and the package was delivered within few days. So far so good. Unfortunately the item didn't fulfill my expectations due to several problems related to the integration with my car, so I decided to return the item. At that time, I had been testing the item for less than a week: I got the item on September 26th, did a test-installation in my car on the 29th, and on October 4 I made the decision of returning it. So I sent an e-mail to the shop telling them, that I needed to return the item (according to my Right of Withdrawel within the EU and especially Germany). From the date of reception (September 26th) until the date where I informed the shop about my decision of returning the item (October 4th) I counted 8 days. So I didn't expect any problems because it was within the period of 14 days. But the first answer I got from the shop, was that the date of return was already expired! Say what?! I didn't understand that. So I informed them about the issues I have with the item, and the reason for returning it, but the shop wrote that it wasn't their mistake, and instead I should contact the importer/manufacturer. Of course the shop was right about that the issues were not their mistake. But it was irrelevant, since I just wanted to return the item. So I kept writing that I needed to return it and I also guaranteed, that the item was kept in a perfect condition. But it didn't help – although they replied my e-mail everytime, my specific request was completely ignored without further comments! Telling the shop, that I then had to give them the lowest rating and sharing my bad experience with other people, the shop informed me about if I didn't withdraw my "False allegations", then they would involve their lawyer. False allegations?? Again I don't understand. I am just telling about the facts and my experience, like most Internet shoppers do. Lesson learned: I cannot trust this shop anymore because they let me down since they ignored my Right of Withdrawel. If you are not 100% sure about an item and might need to return it, then I definetely cannot recommend buying it at this shop!

review_text: Few months ago I purchased a product on eBay from ATP Autotelie, now it broke because of a clear defect (it broke in two parts), and due to its breakage I was close to get my car engine completely burned. I had to spend more money to replace the defective product on an emergency basis, with a lot of time waste. Not even three months were passed, so the product was and still is under purchase warranty coverage, which is defined by the UE Council directive 85/374/CEE of 25th July 1985. However, ATP Autotelie has blocked all ways to contact them or rise any kind of issue. Therefore, I tried try to assert my customer rights through the PayPal claiming system, but the seller invented the excuse that somehow I “altered” the product, which is clearly false and can be easily verified from the picture I sent them. Anyway, PayPal decided to support the fraud and rejected my claim. The matter does not end here, I am reporting what happened (all of which can be proven with documentation in hand) first here on TrustPilot, and then I am turning to a consumer defense association to take legal action, not only against the seller but also against PayPal. This is not so much for an economic problem, but because people cannot be defrauded in this way, it is a question of principle and a question of law, both national and European community laws. **** Update **** After the review was published on TrustPilot, I was contacted by ATP Autoteile, unlocking the possibility to message them on eBay messaging system (but why it was blocked, nobody said). They behaved like they didn't know anything about the claim, that looks quite suspicious to me: did eBay arbitrarily take the initiative to reject my complaint without even informing the seller and without any reasoning? Let's take this as the truth, since the level of eBay service is so poor that can actually arrive at this point. After this, they formally apologized (formally) and accepted to refund the faulty product (except shipping costs), without wanting the broken product back. Then. we had days and days of endless email exchange to undergo the steps of the refund process, several their emails were also sent me twice from different email address. If I could count all the time I lost to reply and send all the information they asked, probably I had to receive three-four times the due amount, but probably this was exactly the idea under such behavior. Obviously I just received the refund of the faulty product (except shipping costs), that is already a huge step on towards the right direction, but the experience was so frustrating that I cannot avoid helping others to avoid my same mistake.

review_text: Your typical shady online retailer. Good prices, fast delivery as long as there's no problem, ordered quite a few things but never more. That's when they show their true morale. When they see it's a never ending story (completely their own fault), they decided it'll probably cost to much to honor the agreement (despite me spending hundreds of euro for a lot of parts in the same order)  and just back away leaving me stranded witouth the most cruicial part, one out of four shock absorbers . The "customer service" is a joke, they have no feeling for right and wrong and will never go outside the manuscript, regardless if they messed up completely and put a customer in a seriously bad situation. Even the people in charge of customer service totaly lacks basic knowledge or just don't care. Will be posting the email conversations when I have the time so everyone can read it and weep. More than 70 emails back and forth over the course of almost 3 months to deal with the whole shitstorm with a bad ending (yeah, that's right) so will pack it up nicely. Stay away, trust me. Truly, truly horrible organisation. EDIT Reply to ATP:s reply: Yes, you refunded me the for the "second" shipping cost because you should have added that item in the forst order, you lost my order, it was greatly delayedand you sent me the wrong item in an opened and beat up box. So I have paid ONE shipping cost already according to our agreement, but still not recieved the item you agreed to send free of shipping. When you sent me the wrong shockabsorber in a opened and beat up box, which I sent back to you, you only refunded the shockabsorber and you refuse to send me a new one without me paying for the shipping cost again! Maybe it's easier to understand if I put it like this: 1. First order. Lost, delayed and wrongly handled. Shipping paid. 2. Second order. The item that should have been added to the first one (plus I added a bunch of other things=more money for you). Shipping cost paid again, and for the item of course. 3. ONE shipping cost refunded according to agreement. (1 of 2 shipping costs paid) 4. Wrong item recieved and returned. 5. Wrong item refunded only. (Back at square one, with me missing an item that should have been sent in the first order.) 6. You refuse to send a new one for some absurd reason, even though you have sent me the wrong one. review_text: I’m pretty sure that this review makes no difference to ATP or my case, but hopefully people will think twice before buying anything from this company. I purchased a Sachs clutch kit from ATP, for my Audi A4. The payment and delivery went fine and quick, which is probably the only positive thing I have to say about this company. We had scheduled a repair at a local mechanic for a gearbox and clutch replacement, so we delivered the ATP clutch as per agreement to the mechanic. However, when the mechanic went to fit the new clutch to the car, he noticed that the clutch didn’t fit and was actually a LUK clutch (completely different brand to Sachs). The clutch was branded LUK on one side and Sachs on the other. As the car was taking up space on a lift and the mechanic couldn’t wait for a new clutch to be delivered, we had to buy the correct clutch locally. Unfortunately it didn’t come with a clutch release bearing, so we had to use the one supplied with the clutch kit from ATP. I called ATP and explained the situation (in German, as apparently only one or two ATP employees speaks English) and asked if it was possible for me to return the incorrect clutch without the bearing, to which they replied yes. I returned the clutch as agreed, and for a long period of time I heard nothing from them, so I decided to call them to see if they received the clutch. After a couple of calls, they informed me that they had in fact received the clutch, but that the bearing was missing and that they could not refund me as the set was not complete. I tried to explain the situation several times with no luck and no sympathy. ATP sells the exact clutch release bearing on their website and I informed them, that I would happily pay for the bearing that I had used from the kit, so they could replace it in the kit. But for some reason this is impossible to do for ATP. In theory I could just get the clutch back, buy the bearing, put it in the box and return a complete set. I have now spent several hours on the phone, trying to first of all get through to them on the phone, which is a nightmare. And when I finally manage to get through, nobody speaks English (fortunately I speak a little German). The employees that answer the phone cannot make any decisions and needs to speak to their supervisors and promises to call back, which they NEVER do, so you have to start all over every time you get through to them. To make things even better, now ATP wants me to pay them to return the wrong clutch to me.

Promising a few days on their website doesn’t exactly help when (A) the order takes a couple of days more before it’s sendt, and (B) it in addition will take between three and five days at least at the local post office. I’ll be glad to pay the few extra bucks to get the tire within a couple of days instead of waiting two to three weeks and have to park the bike in the meantime. My advice would be to never order from these people at all. The alternative really can’t be worse when it comes to deliverance and customer service. In addition I can see from the answers on the other complaints here that they are trying to excuse themselves. But there’s not one single hint to them actually improving. Stay clear and use someone else. For your own pleasure. Their repeated “sorry” comments here on Trustpilot is a bad way of saying that they probably never will improve. Before they post their automatic “we are sorry” text here. How exactly is that going to help us when we are depending on the tire and can’t ride until it’s delivered? It might be naive to believe your “3-5 days”, but it’s *your* promise.  It ours. Trustpilot really needs to ad negative ratings for scammers like MCDackonline and Delticom AG

Still highly recommended 5 star, but remember the handles and casing needing to be covered ideally for travelling.

review_text: I love that little composting toilet and have one in the van and one in the house. Our house has only one bathroom and when we have guests, more than one person often feels the urge at the same time... I love the semi self-closing, quiet lid and the simple elegant design. My only gripe is that the urine receptacle is not easy to completely empty out (not self-draining, when inverted), because of the shape of the top: a little liquid always remains, even when you turn it completely upside down. I empty it in the garden under a tree and immediately flush with water, so it's not a big issue, but there is room for improvement here. I've owned a big Sun Mar composting toilet for 25 years (bought for Y2K...), which has come in handy on occasion, but is a pain to empty and clean and needs it's own room, basically, which is not practical for us. The little Trelino is exactly what I was looking for.

review_text: We love our Trevino! We traded out our Campco for the Trelino 4 months and couldn’t be happier.  We have a converted van and the medium Trevino fits in our toilet/extra seat box with room to spare. The Trevino is sturdy, comfortable and well built, not tippy at all. The pee jugs fits into a plastic grocery bag along with the Lysol wipes and we can discreetly carry it into any restroom for dumping. The poo bag we tie up and dump in the garbage just like disposable diapers. We got an extra pee jug so we always have our Trelino ready to go. It takes a little bit to learn exactly where to sit to properly use the separator but the instruction booklet was very helpful. The 1:7 vinegar water solution works well to keep the pee jug scale free.  We travel in our van 6-9 months each year and the Trelino has really been a nice upgrade. Spendy but well worth it!

review_text: Before I shopped at Felgenoutlet I made a big mistake shopping at a small independent online seller in Germany. I was sold wheels I could not get TUV certification for. The seller made it impossible to return the wheels. It ended with hiring a lawyer to get my money back and is ongoing. I wish I had have gone to Felgenoutlet first. Here is why. 1. They quickly and professionally answered my questions 2. TUV certified Wheels and include all the necessary paperwork for your car. Fit for your car with TUV papers CONFIRMED. 3. Lightning fast delivery 4. Included FREE Wheel bolts and center rings! 5. Competitive pricing. 6. Multi language support - email and phone! For people who are from outside of Germany and may not know how TUV works here are some things you must know: If you are changing wheels on your car they MUST be TUV certified. If you are driving around on wheels without tuv certification and get into an accident you will have NO insurance coverage and be in a world of trouble, even when its NOT your fault. It is NOT worth the risk. When shopping for wheels be sure to look for TUV certified sellers ONLY. DO NOT shop with any seller that does not have this! Felgenoutlet is one of the TOP sellers of wheels in Germany. They know the certification requirements and law. They will make sure what you are buying is 100% legal for your car. They will inform you if there are any concerns or mistakes. Shopping at Felgenoutlet you know what you are getting is quality tuv approved and will keep you safe and legal. Only 2 things went wrong: They sent the wrong Hub Centric Rings. I ordered 64-54.1 and I got 64-56.6 instead. I was told I would get the correct ones mailed to me. They never arrived so I had to go purchase my own. This was frustrating as it delayed my installation. When the packages arrived some of them where badly damaged. I went through every package with the DPD guy and everything was OK. It just looked bad, Very poorly packaged for shipping wheels. But do keep in mind they came strait from the manufacture (Tec) and not Felgenoutlet. The Wheels arrived super fast! 3 working days but because they came from the manufacture I was not provided with any shipping or tracking info. I would like to see this change in the future. Despite these small issues I would say you can shop with confidence here. Its safe legal and legit. UPDATE: After reading my issues almost a month later Felgenoutlet sent me the correct center rings and also sent me a free care package with wheel cleaning tools! I did not expect that. That is good customer service! I hope this helped you good luck.

review_text: This review is for the company Autodoc or autoteiledirekt.de (they seem to operate under a bunch of different names, so I posted here and on Autodoc reviews). The short version: Absolutely terrible customer service, bordering on a scam. Order somewhere else! The very long one for those who care: I ordered a bunch of parts from them and to be fair the items are what I expected and do their jobs but 2 days after the items were supposed to be at my house (shipped inside Germany so no excuse there) I called them up and after pretty unfriendly interaction with their customer service guy I got promised that it would go out that day. So, if it says 2 days, expect a week. While I was talking to him I noticed the parts where now 30 Euros cheaper on a 200 Euro order and I asked him for a deal. I would have taken store credit, even a complimentary sponge or a packet of gummy bears or something that showed any interest in their customers, but he wasn't willing to budge. Fair enough there too, they don't have to. So, I told him I would just order the stuff again and return the first package and since they already delivered the parts too late for me I had all the time in the world (second package was late by the same time frame too). I even bought their safe order (sicher bestellen) feature on the first order, which states that I can return the uninstalled parts for a full refund for any reason within a 100 days or something like that. Since the boxes are just sitting here and haven’t even been opened it shouldn't have been a problem. A week after I filed for the return I haven't even gotten a mail saying that it is being processed other than their automated instant reply so I called them up again. I didn’t even get an answer the first 4 times I called even though it kept telling me constantly I was next in line. After 15 Minutes and 27 Seconds you get dropped from the line each time so you get to try again. I have a headset and plenty of time while i was doing other things so I just kept calling. Even tried calling them from 3 lines at once (I got bored) and you get the same message on all of them. That was around 10am on a regular business day. Never got through to anyone then so I tried again in the afternoon and after the second round of waiting I actually got someone who couldn't even say hello or good bye or anything and I tried my best to be extra friendly. I got some results in the form of six emails (one for each part I ordered) saying my return was accepted and an attached PDF Return Form for every part. Seemed like progress but it also said that my return mailers would come in separate emails which still haven't arrived 5 days later. I guess I will listening to some more annoying music and automated messages next week. At this point I fully expect them to either not answer at all or at best be extremely rude again. Chances of me getting the full refund, that their extra safe order service promises are slim to none and I bet they will give me the full runaround for that too. Calling it what it is at this point is a Scam. I will change this review accordingly if they manage to surprise me and not do any of that, after all terrible service and late deliveries aren't a scam if the parts are what you bought but at this point it sure looks like a Scam when it comes to their return policies and safe order options. Update (26.06.2018): I guess complaining loudly on the internet does help since their english speaking customer service called me up first thing monday and sent me the return mailer (just one though even though I got two boxes but since they already had all the heavy stuff in one box and the 2 super light things in a seperate one I figured they might as well go in a single box. Didn't want to argue over this but I took a bunch of pictures anyway). The english speaking customer service rep was very nice, which was a welcome change so I guess I'll be carefully optimistic and wait. Update (09.07.2018): Turns out they actually did send me three labels - in yet again three separate emails - just two ended up in spam. I guess since it took 40something emails (not even kidding) to get to this point. So I sent the three packages in the same arrangement they came here and apparently they received them on Jul. 2nd. Still waiting to hear anything further. Don't hold your breath on getting your money in any sort of timely fashion back. Mind you I started the Process over a month ago on June 3rd. I do realize the return proves and banks and all that take their sweet time too. I don't have a problem with that, but this is just ridiculous. How does a company with that terrible of a customer service stay in business these days? I've head better customer service from Indian tech support scammers than these guys. I’m curious what happens next. My guess is I do get some money back at some point or another but not even close to the amount I paid with all kinds of bogus charges and “service” fees as a justification. I guess we will see.

Dass Sie sich nicht ernst genommen fühlten und ein Gespräch als unangemessen empfunden haben, ist keinesfalls unser Anspruch. Wir nehmen Ihre Rückmeldung daher sehr ernst. Dass die Auslieferung zusätzlich durch logistische Engpässe und Feiertage verzögert wurde, ist verständlicherweise frustrierend, aber leider nicht immer vermeidbar. Dennoch hätten wir Sie proaktiv und transparent darüber informieren müssen. Wir wissen Ihre offene Kritik zu schätzen – nur so können wir besser werden. Auch wenn wir Ihre Enttäuschung nachvollziehen, würden wir uns freuen, wenn Sie uns zu einem späteren Zeitpunkt doch noch eine Chance geben würden, Sie von unserem Service zu überzeugen. review_text: Unfortunately, I cannot recommend dackonline.se based on my experience. I ordered a complete set of winter wheels on November 9th, with a promised delivery time of a maximum of 14 working days. This deadline passed by several weeks without me receiving any clear explanation. During this period, I was given conflicting information every time I called customer service – sometimes they claimed the tires couldn’t be delivered and tried to get me to cancel the order, while other times they promised that the wheels would be shipped “this week or next week.” None of it was true. At the same time, the exact same wheel package continued to be shown as “available” on their website, which felt both misleading and unprofessional. The customer service by phone cannot make any decisions at all; they only act as intermediaries and constantly refer to “the other department” that responds by email. This creates a Catch-22 situation – the phone support can’t help, and the email support doesn’t reply in time. Now they have also informed me that the product I ordered is sold out, despite it being listed as available during my entire waiting period. I have been forced to try to solve the issue myself, contact the Consumer Agency, and argue for an alternative, even though the fault lies entirely with them. It is extremely frustrating as a customer to have to chase answers, be transferred around, and receive different information with every contact. Especially when winter tires are legally required in Sweden and you depend on receiving your delivery on time. I recommend buying from a more reliable supplier that can actually keep their delivery times and provide consistent information to their customers.

review_text: Bought a race chip march 2025, installed in my ml 350 diesel bluetec, seemed to be a slight increase in performance but I was getting occasional hiccups and app not working, the check engine light also came on, i removed racechip and check engine light went off, I contacted racechip asking to return it, they kept replying with solutions to remedy it and asking me to keep it, eventually they sent me a return shipping label, it is now stuck at customs in Germany, I contacted racechip asking why it’s stuck at customs for two weeks, they said they contacted UPS and were waiting for a reply, I contacted UPS immediately and was told racechip needed to contact customs and apparently racechip had not contacted customs nor UPS as they claimed and had not supplied required clearance documents ( no fees due) so it’s on their end, not sure if this is intentional to leave it sitting at customs so return window passes, but certainly looks suspicious, there are other complaints online re: racechips difficult return process, especially when returning for a faulty chip, am skeptical, looks like will have to dispute charge with credit card company and file complaint with BBB . Ps, apparently racechip have just disputed this post, I have all documentation to prove this review is genuine and that I was a real customer.
supplier_response: Hello Noel, thank you for the feedback. We will explain you the situation. We have no influence on the customs clearance process. Unfortunately, there may be delays of a few days. UPS was demonstrably contacted by us and the refund was already made beginning of May. We offered you support since our aim is that you have completely functional product. There are occasional vehicles where the RaceChip does not achieve the expected results although it is individually designed and programmed for the engine. It must be pointed out here that identical engines can have a different serial dispersion due to manufacturing tolerances. If the engine differs too much from the standard it can happen in exceptional cases that the RaceChip does not harmonize perfectly right away. The engine's general condition does also play an important role in relation to chiptuning. If the engine does not perform like expected with the RaceChip our customers can always contact our technical support. Usually they can match the tuning software afterwards in order to achieve the expected results in the end. In case the final results should still not meet the expectations we refund payment. Best regards, Your RaceChip-Team

review_text: I installed the RaceChip S on my Mk6 VW Jetta 1.8.  After 3 months I decided to take it out. First off, there was no fuel mileage gain at all, in fact my average MPG dropped from 16.6 city to 15.2 city. Second, when set at 4 and 5, the engine would have misses and send traction control and tire pressure codes every so often. When set a 3 and lower, these issues did not come up. So basically, I was not able to fully enjoy the 30+ hp gain or the 15% mpg gain claim either and I guess I was "satisfied in the first place" according to RaceChip. (see RaceChip reply below) All I know is that after a few months driving with the chip installed, I got tired of the glitches and no improvement in MPG and uninstalled it. So NOW I'm not satisfied, and I would not recommend RaceChip.
supplier_response: Hello Roy, please contact our technical support team like you already did when you were satisfied in first place: https://www.racechip.com/service-support/customer-support.html Engines have different serial tolerances, which means that the performance numbers of the maker is not always the real performance of the motor. The performance increase includes a tolerance of up to 8%. The performance also changes depending on the mileage of the engine. Depending on the power distribution of the engine, there is a different power delta. This means that the maximum power of the respective motor is achieved even on different mappings. That is the reason for the different mappings. Best regards, Your RaceChip-Team

review_text: I was very sceptical about this product but I have fitted the basic RaceChip 'S' (delivered from Germany) to my 2015 KIA Proceed GT...and yes! They work. It's not been dyno tested but blimey the improvement in performance is very noticeable. Turbo kicks in earlier, more power/torque (claimed +33HP/77NM) and fuel consumption is slightly better but I'm only a week or so in using it. Easy to fit and no warning lights or issues. I'm on setting 4/5 which is manually done on the 'S' version so I might go up to 5 once my ECU has adapted. These only alter turbo boost pressure and injection and timing within safe limits so the factory ECU stays standard but just adapts to what  signals the RaceChip intercepts and adjusts. Tailored for your car and the instructions/connectors are spot on. 👍

review_text: Ordered the top of the range Racechip for a 318D N47 2010 BMW E90 in July In September I “upgraded” to a e93 N47 2011 320D (same engine just different factory power) Threw EML’s so contacted support. Racechip informed me the unit needed to be retuned to make it work with my new car. The harness I had transferred directly over, but I was informed even tho the engine is more o less identical I needed to pay 165€ to get a Racechip GTS to get it to work in my car. So 2 months later after having paid £399 and the “new” GTS being on offer for 399 at the time I had no choice but to pay the 165€ cost for a replacement. Terrible customer relations, borderline theft and a total mockery of the free programming “claim” plastered all over the website. Buyers beware, only buy if you plan to keep the car for a while. Used Racechip for years for 5+ cars and recommended to many family members, but won’t recommend anymore. Feel robbed. *As a response to the reply from racechip: If you purchase the best chip available at the time, at the same price as the “new number one product” you wouldn’t expect to have to pay 1/4 more for the same item. Being only 2 months between the transactions too. I wouldn’t have minded if it wasn’t the EXACT same engine. I purposely purchased my new car in mind that I could swap all my additions/mods across. Hence my poor review, just a warning to all that the free reprogramming is in fact not free even if you are getting the exact same product just branded differently.

You actually received an Upgrade, a brand new Racechip because of a different circuit board and we add the app for the half of the price for you as a gesture of goodwill. Depending on the software we have different develop procedures and costs. It is not even the product we have to change. It is also a different software. We did not charge you for the reprogramming. Our RaceChip are exclusively produced in Germany, therefore comply with the highest quality standards - which our customers, as well as ourselves, are proud of. In order to maintain the existing quality, a continuous improvement of the technology, in the context of the development, is the highest priority. review_text: I bought a RaceChip GTS for my 2017 Mini JCW. I didn't actually need the extra HP as the car was already quite fast. However, I have always enjoyed playing with engines and installing the chip and testing it was fun. I did some road tests (no dyno) and I don't feel big differences until map 4 (as expected). Starting at map 5 I hear a different rumble from the engine and quicker response, especially at low to mid RPM. With map 7 the car simply flies when you press the pedal, but retains all its comfort even when driving at low revs. I have yet to estimate mpg, but the horsepower/torque increase feels real. I've had a few mail exchanges with support, which have been great.

review_text: Ordered a Racechip for my 2016 BMW M5 Competition on 19/06/22.  Filled in all the all the online details confirming model make of car.  After a week it was delivered. I sent them pictures of the actual fitting on 28th June.  They said they would send out the correct harness.  They sent it by economy courier which arrived 9 days later.  Guess what even after I had sent them the pictures of the correct connectors they sent the wrong fittings again.  6th July back to customer support.  7th July I receive a response asking me to send them pictured of the connector on the car.  I did that the first time! However I resent them to get a further response asking me to check  if I am taking the correct sensors off.  They sent me 2 pictures of a 540! I believe which has different intercoolers and the boost sensors for the M5 are on the side not the front of the intercoolers.  No response from Racechip.  I send a follow up email.  11th July message from them we will send you a new harness when it arrives.  no estimated date?  13th July message to say it has been shipped.  22nd July harness arrives and is correct one.  They could have at least sent in by 24 hour courier.  If you buy from these people and have a problem be aware of my storey.  I also called them on a number of occasions.  Customer care is poor at best

review_text: The RaceChip has made a big difference.  I was hesitant until I saw a tuning company I trust do dyno runs, as I've seen a lot of negativity suggesting the chips are not giving the power they claim. The install took longer than it should, as the instructions are both very poor in quality, and shockingly wrong.  I have a 2020 Alfa Romeo Giulia, and the connections are labelled the wrong way around! Luckily one is 3 pins and the other 4 pins, and I checked before trying to plug them in.  A lot of people will not check, and could damage the connections, in particular since the connection at the back of the engine is difficult to see, so done more by touch than sight.  You don't expect instructions or labels to be wrong! I'm unsure on the Bluetooth connection.  As there's no Apple/Android Carplay option, you have to unlock your phone and adjust it.  It means you end up leaving it in Race all the time, but if I was doing a long journey, I'd change to Eco. Decide to overtake on your journey, and you're in Eco, you're missing loads of power.  Adjust the setting on your phone mid journey and you're breaking the law.  It makes the option compromised, but better than having to pop the bonnet. review_text: Recently bought the RaceChip Rs with app control. Installing was super easy, probably took around 5 minutes. I let the car idle for a few minutes to make sure nothing was wrong, then took it out for a quick drive to see if I noticed a difference. I cycled through Eco, sport, and race. There was a noticeable difference between the 3 and a difference between the "stock tune" and race tune. Of course I was just doing an old fashioned butt dyno but the car felt like it had more on tap then it used to. For the RS with the Bluetooth connection it was 379usd (they were running a Christmas sale). All in all so far I am super pleased with it and have no complaints. Customer service was great and shipping was fairly quick seeing as how I'm in Alaska and it was shipped from Germany.

review_text: I purchased this chip in the black Friday offer, like most I had my doubts about the company and product due to it all seeming a little to easy to get such power gains. If I was to take my car to a dyno for a tune it was going to take it from 185bhp to 217bhp which I was really excited about doing. However, when I saw that the chip was going to offer a gain from 185bhp to 240bhp I had to investigate. Due to the chip being on offer making more sense for me to spend the money and the company offering a 30 day return period I decided to give it a go. The product arrived in 4 days which was great as I live in UK and it was shipped from Germany. The product install was done in 10-15 mins due to the personal install package they send you via email. So far been driving with it for a few days and it was worth every penny, the car can now bearly put its power down in second without spinning its absolutely fantastic. As a student, it really was a risk spending so much money but going fast is my passion so I don't have any regrets when it comes to the chip. Hope this helps someone in the same position as I was about a tuning box. UPDATE - Used product for 4 years with no issues and been happy with the product since day 1, 4 years later i have bought a new car and i messaged racechip to get the chip reprogrammed only to find out they only support this for up to 24 months after purchase. Although this was mentioned in the T&C's it was not made clear at the time of purchase and has left me disappointed. Even if they offered a service where you can pay to get the chip changed at a reduced price to buying another as a show that they care about long term customers would be nice.

review_text: Well, I wasn't sure about chip tuning… like… I really wasn’t sure. I had just bought my dream car – one that wasn’t killing the environment, but also had a bit of poke and gets me up and down the mountain that I live up in Austria – even in snow and ice.  (It’s a UK registered Jaguar XF 20 AWD with 180 ps and 430 nm). So, its a proper nice car, but not that pokey (acceleration) as I had been driving a Skoda VRS before, and that goes as fast as Donald J Trump after a cheeseburger, so, naturally after a while I began to think I really should have got the Jaguar 25 AWD with 241ps). It was then that I understood that essentially the two cars are identical (suspension, brakes, interior, etc.) with the exception that the ‘more powerful’ and much more expensive 25 AWD is just faster because of the twin turbo, so. Suddenly, I worked out, I might be able to get 25 AWD performance for a few hundred Euros, rather than several thousand it would get to buy the 25 AWD which are about 20% more expensive on the second hand market. So, I asked a mate of mine who drives ridiculous German cars: S6, AMG Jeep type thing – utterly bonkers. He doesn’t talk much normally (he just likes his cars), and his reaction was weird. For the first time in a lifetime he just wouldn’t shut up about how ‘effing brilliant chip tuning was. Well, that avalanche of praise from an otherwise ‘quiet man’ convinced me and the next day, I took the plunge and ordered the smallest chip (the S) to test it out and see what it might do. It arrived a couple of days later. The wife was curious (she always gets to the post first) and I told her it was a thing to save fuel. She was totally suspicious “Why doesn’t everyone have one then?” she asked. “Round here?” I countered looking up and down the valley. We live surrounded by mountain farmers who drive tractors by day and big Audis by night. “I expect most already do… Its only 169 Euros” I said. “I’ll order one for you tomorrow, just give me the cash.” I could see her weighing up how much cat food she could buy for that much money, and to be honest, it wasn’t even a mildly fair contest. Within seconds she was back to annimal videos on her phone.  Job done. With that now taken care of, it was time to get it installed. Well, I’m an academic by trade, so more of a philospohy type, than a spanner and wrench one; not really very ‘hands on’, but also not stupid. Anyway, it took me about 10 minutes to get it all wired up, they give you a whole bunch of instructions (with pictures), that make IKEA building look difficult, so its really a nice piece of customer service. With this done, I then took the Jag out for a test drive, and the difference was noticeable. I had been missing that little kick in the small of the back when accelerating (yes, sad but true, I have been missing the little VRS – who would believe it?), and now, it seemed like the Jag had suddenly gone from a nice looker, to a ‘nearly’ exciting performer.  I drove up and down the mountain once on the winding serpentine roads; night time, all to myself, and sure enough, found myself grinning like a school boy. There you go compatriots, that is what you need. That is the real test, whether it makes you smile or not, and it did… but, not quite enough. I realised I needed the bigger chip, the GTS. (Naturally, there is a whole marketing strategy behind the chip tuning industry, and I am now in the thick of it). Well, there you go, that’s my story. In my opinion, the thing to look out for (especially in a diesel like my Jag XF and it’ll be the same in a 5 series or an A6, or an E class) is how much the torque increases - not so much the Horse Power.: although to be fair, they say the ps has gone from 180 to 214 PS, so that's not bad either What you are looking at is a signficant power gain further down the rev spectrum, say mid- 2k for nm: as well as a noticiable one than over 5k for bp. So, this means when your mates down the pub (Kneipe for my German friends; Wirtshaus where I live), ask you (as they will) 'Wieviel PS alter?", and with the GTS chip (the big brother) you have to talk about the stonking, beautiful, galvansing 540 nm you have (and possibly leave out the 230 ps). Thing is, you don't get to honestly say “380 ps alter”, which is what the big V6 3.0 Diesel Jaguar has with EXACTLY THE SAME amount of Newtons as the GTS chip would give my modest cat!!! At the moment my RaceChip ‘S’ tuned Jag has 503 NM with a chip that cost me 160 Euros, and if I do eventually decide to get the GTS chip, and drive around with 540 Newtownians, I may not have the nervy-edgy racy feel of 380 horses, but I will have the firm, powerful push with more NM than the brand new ‘BMW 540’, with only 500 nm. I will have 5 more nm than the legendary 2020 Porsche Carrera 4S, for considerably less, and that is probably ‘it’ in a nutshell. "More for less". There, put that in your pipe and smoke it.

night time, all to myself, and sure enough, found myself grinning like a school boy. there you go compatriots, that is what you need. that is the real test, whether it makes you smile or not, and it did… but, not quite enough. i realised i needed the bigger chip, the gts. (naturally, there is a whole marketing strategy behind the chip tuning industry, and i am now in the thick of it). well, there you go, that’s my story. in my opinion, the thing to look out for (especially in a diesel like my jag xf and it’ll be the same in a 5 series or an a6, or an e class) is how much the torque increases - not so much the horse power.: although to be fair, they say the ps has gone from 180 to 214 ps, so that's not bad either what you are looking at is a signficant power gain further down the rev spectrum, say mid- 2k for nm: as well as a noticiable one than over 5k for bp. so, this means when your mates down the pub (kneipe for my german friends; wirtshaus where i live), ask you (as they will) 'wieviel ps alter?", and with the gts chip (the big brother) you have to talk about the stonking, beautiful, galvansing 540 nm you have (and possibly leave out the 230 ps). thing is, you don't get to honestly say “380 ps alter”, which is what the big v6 3.0 diesel jaguar has with exactly the same amount of newtons as the gts chip would give my modest cat!!! at the moment my racechip ‘s’ tuned jag has 503 nm with a chip that cost me 160 euros, and if i do eventually decide to get the gts chip, and drive around with 540 newtownians, i may not have the nervy-edgy racy feel of 380 horses, but i will have the firm, powerful push with more nm than the brand new ‘bmw 540’, with only 500 nm. i will have 5 more nm than the legendary 2020 porsche carrera 4s, for considerably less, and that is probably ‘it’ in a nutshell. "more for less". there, put that in your pipe and smoke it.

review_text: Ordered my GTS chip & XLR and received them extremely fast from Germany to Washington state. For my 2019 Camaro LT, install was simple and straightforward, as was removal and reinstalltion (removed to have yearly maintenance) Initial thoughts were "is that all?" Most of the gains are felt around 4th gear and with the XLR set to R, it quite literally threw me back in my seat. I am currently experiencing some very subtle jerk n' thrust on take off occasionally and a little roughness on idle. And given that I am not a "pedal to the metal" driver, I'm wondering if it has to do with the chip. My only other complaint is I tried to purchase bluetooth capability for my XLR but didn't get it and wasn't able to get customer service to fix it. Other than that, the delivery and install was smooth, performance is INCREDIBLE and I hope it continues to provide the gains without any side effects. I can't speak to other models, but I definitely recommend for the Camaro. Buy it.

review_text: I purchased a Racechip GTS with app for my 2020 BMW M2 competition. The installation was simple and the performance gains were noticeable. I was happy with the results however after a few months  I got a malfunction drivetrain on my dash and an engine light. I turned off the Racechip and the car ran fine without any fault codes. It would happen every-time I would drive the car more than an hour. It would start to run rough and then it would display a drivetrain malfunction fault code and the car would go into limp mode. I would pull over turn off the Racechip on the app and turn the car off. I would restart car and everything was back to normal. I tried several more time with the same disappointing results.  I contacted customer service by email and went back and forth with no solution. They stated that I needed to explain the problem that was occurring which I laughed and said I just did explain. Then they said that they can’t help. I am not surprised from Racechip’s reply. There are so many bad reviews about Racechip. I should have listened. But I gave them a chance but boy was I wrong. Horrible customer service. People beware of Racechip they are selling inferior product that will cause problems to your car. They do not stand behind their product. These piggy back chips are riddled with problems you best bet is to load a tune to your ECU for example: Carbahn. I have learned my lesson by trusting Racechip and their shady business practices and useless customer service.Racechip product # 7432005015179 I’m going to try to explain this again. I start the car drive for about an hour, within that hour everything runs fine. After that hour , while I was driving at the speed of 55 mph, it started to run rough and then a fault code and limp mode. ( I was not accelerating just normal speed) I pull over and turn the Racechip off and turn the ignition off too. I start the car again with the Racechip off and the car is running normal with no codes showing. Another situation, after driving a hour or more, I was coming home. I pulled up to my driveway of my house. I put the car into reverse the car started to run rough and then it stalled. ( no fault codes this time) I Tried to start car but it didn’t start. I turn off the Racechip and the car off. I waited a few minutes and then started the car with Racechip off. It started and ran fine. It always run fine until I drive more than an hour so isn’t that strange to you. It occurs at normal driving. It occurs after driving awhile. Now Racechip has completely ignored my emails and they will not provide a solution. This is what they do and they are getting away with it. Once again do not waste your money on Racechip instead invest in a ECU tune. I have used many ECU tunes and I never had  problems like the ones that I have experienced with Racechip. Do not purchase. They give you the run around until you give up. Look at the respond below. Update as of November 2020: Racechip provided me with a replacement Racechip unit. It was finally established the unit was defective. I installed the new unit and have not had any problems. I have to say what a difference in power and the car runs smoother with the Racechip. I noticed this when I had the unit uninstalled and waiting for the new Racechip to arrive. In addition the gas mileage is way better with the Racechip too. I do want to thank all the individuals at Racechip customer service for all their help. Thanks, you have made me a believer again.

review_text: I ordered the race chip for my Audi S3 8v(2015) on a weekend, got it by Thurs, remembering that covid can still mess with tracking I was impressed. Chirping 4 wheels without launch control is pretty cool and alot of fun. It's affordable and worth double for the power output. review_text: It's been two weeks, zendesk says my ticket is closed, you said you would provide an update to solve the issue of loss of power / limp mode under acceleration. The box requests 197/198ish mpa of rail fuel pressure, car tries to give that then boom, drop of pressure and limp mode, rail pressure sensor drops from 4v to 1v and accordingly it's pressure stops copying the desired pressure sensor mpa and goes right down, then limp mode. This behavior is sporadic and whilst can be replicated easily now, there are a couple of hard pulls when it doesn't drop pressure / plays nicely. All of this relates to hard pulls 3-4k (car pulling great until just under 4k, then the drop off / limp). A second way the problem happens is as follows: Sometimes boost seems much slower at around 3k than it should, a kind-of hesitation, almost naturally aspirated feel, if the car is then pushed a bit more, say to 3.5/4k that will also cause limp mode. All of this relates to just moderate driving, and doesn't meet the same criteria of the first way this problem happens (because in this circumstance fuel rail pressure is much lower, therefore the problem is not simply rail pressure being too high, as it could happen at 3-3.5k revs this way, which is alot less pressure than 197+/- @ 4k  ...) I've noted down what all the settings request in terms of fuel pressure, and I expect an update and one that justify me buying the GTS, because if your update lowers this value then it's obviously not worth my money paying for a detuned GTS tuning box, but like I said its not simply fuel rail pressure being too high, my instinct is it's to-do with voltage drops or something. I appreciate every vehicle is different, but my vehicle is highly maintained, low mileage, good fuels etc, your box worked okish for one month (limp mode every 2-3 weeks). Now it's constant limp mode by just medium/hard acceleration. It's a massive headache. I don't think without severely crippling the box's performance that you'll get it to work, but I paid all that money for the top model + Bluetooth to ensure top performance. I enquired about a refund on grounds that the thing is not working and you said you would try another update before offering the refund. That's two weeks ago. If your update can't offer the performance I paid for then let's just get a refund set up. I will update this review accordingly based on your replies to my emails. I would like to specifically know which parameters you edited in the first and only update you've given me, as it seems worse since then. I have a proper scanning tablet, so can check any vehicle parameters or do live data recording of any number of parameters, in graph form, if that would help. review_text: Racechip GTS installed on a Skoda Kodiaq 2.0TSI 'CZPA' engine. From order to delivery the process was slick and fast given the package was shipped halfway round the world. Customer services were responsive when I requested more pictures of the sensor placement and the installation instructions supplied in the box were very clear. The install was trickier than expected, largely due to the boost pressure sensor being really only accessible from under the car and the Kodiaq undertray (unlike a Golf or Audi A3) is secured on by many more bolts aswell as screws. I was only able to do this because I had the car up on ramps. Apart from access to the boost pressure sensor, the actual installation of the harness and set-up of the Racechip unit was fantastically simple. Must admit to being initially disappointed by the performance gain, even on Race7. I would best describe it as 'mild'. HOWEVER, I soon realised that this was likely due to the frankly awful stock throttle pedal calibration of the Kodiaq - inconsistent with a dead spot for the first ~20% of pedal travel. Installed a cheap throttle pedal controller which has dramatically improved the responsiveness of the car and you can now fully exploit the power gains from the Racechip GTS to the extent that I have now had to wind the Racechip back to Sport6. My advice to anyone considering a Racechip GTS for a 2.0TSI 'CZPA' engine in a Kodiaq or Tiguan is do it...BUT budget for the Racechip XLR too.

review_text: Absolutely avoid this product!! I'd like to address a few issues with this product which have also been highlighted by others. I Bought the GTS model, upon arrival it came with generic instructions, whilst I appreciate those who are absolute car enthusiast may know where to find the turbo pressure sensor and Map sensor, for the average person just wanting to do a little extra to there car this isnt as straight forward. You have to email them to obtain instructions specifically for your vehicle and from reading their FAQ this is clearly a problem that many consumers have had and never actually been addressed. When you're paying £300 + for a product I'd expect some instructions. After joining other Facebook forums I managed to obtain instructions from other sources as racechip took so long to reply I managed to get it fitted. Upon initially driving the car you can notice the difference almost immediately, clear power and torque increase and loved it. All to good to be true after about a week I began to notice my rev counter appeared to be slipping whilst the chip was on and happened regardless of what mode it was in (race, sport, eco). Approximately 1 week after this my car began judder and was hesitant when putting my foot down and again revs kept slipping. I made contact with racechip and they advised that they would send a new update to my chip, this process was quick to install but the problems I've mentioned above became even more apparent. This Monday I decided I want to nip to shop and get some stuff, not long after I left the house I noticed the issues again and began to smell oil coming through my air vents and smoke from the engine bay. When I stopped and lifted the bonnet it looked like there had been and explosion of oil, immediately began to think I blew a head gasket or done some damage to the engine. review_text: Great performance and quality! I installed the RS unit, Harness, and chip in less than 20 minutes and mounted it carefully next to my normal ECU, the only minor set back that occurred was figuring out where and what the Bluetooth password was, (which is the last 6 digits of the serial number on the unit)  but after that the system booted up properly and it began working quite quickly, taking full effect in about 1.5 - 2 hours. I started out using it on level 3 of [Sport Mode] which by itself made made a huge difference in low end torque and boost, along with a increase in rev range, Later that evening my wife wanted to feel it in “Race Mode” which I agreed to, and switched over the preset, and Oh. My. God. Did it kick my car into high gear, I drive a pretty Quick and well modified performance car as it is, but this was unlike anything I’ve experienced as far as the nature of the car, the acceleration: Brutal. The rev- Range: High, The torque: Head rest smacking. What more is there to say?? Final thoughts: I went into this extremely skeptical, I had seen a lot of conflicting reviews and misinformation about this product and company, along with a lot of paid sponsorships, so I was more than a little Leary at first, but upon installing it in the correct manner and using some common sense, I now love my car even more then I did before.

review_text: I bought the cheapest RaceChip for my SEAT Leon Fr and keeping it on the middle 3 setting I was getting better MPG and better performance.  But after about a month, the car would occasionally hiccup and on one occasion, on the motorway, a dashboard warning came on and the car went into limp mode.  When I got home, I turned off the engine, turned it back on again and it was running fine – no warning lights. So I knocked the setting down to 2 and then 1 and even though it gave me miles of OK driving, it would still hiccup occasionally.  During this time I was emailing customer service who have been absolutely superb throughout.  Then, on setting 1, it started going into limp mode almost continually and even did so again on the motorway, so, on the motorway hard shoulder I turned it to 0 to get back OK. I then contacted customer service who suggested I return it for a re-program.  They supplied the return postage label and I got it back a week later.  Unfortunately, I then got worse MPG on all of the settings.  So I contacted customer service again, just to advise them of the history of operation – I did not request or expect a refund – in my mind I had written the cost off to experience.  However, completely unprompted, they said if I returned it they would give me a full refund.  They again sent a label and issued the refund within a week. That is why I give 4 stars – because their customer service has been superb – just a shame that the chip didn’t work perfectly with my car.

review_text: Brilliant. It's given my throttle the extra punch it needed. Fitted this to a 2001 BMW 330Ci (E46). It's electronic throttle and I've always found it a little laggy. I was sceptical about fitting the RaceChip unit but I'm glad I took the risk. Installation was easy (although the sticky pads are not sticky at all), and the unit and accessories are well made and solid. Performance has been great. Genuinely, the rev range and layout feels better, particularly in the higher settings. I'm a real E46 nerd, and can honestly say that this unit has added great responsiveness to the throttle. S and S+ mode are good for daily driving. R and R+ mode aren't comfortable when in start/stop traffic, but on a clear and open road it's fantastic. This installation has been a nice surprise. It's important to understand that this doesn't add power, or a remap, but it does adjust the sensitivity of your throttle, more so than just planting your foot could ever manage. It puts down the power a lot quicker . Ultimately, it's a sport button for your car. Would definitely recommend.

review_text: Ich bin vor mittlerweile mehr als einem halben Jahr über Instagram auf diese Firma aufmerksam geworden und habe mir probehalber ein paar ihrer Produkte bestellt, seitdem bestelle ich regelmäßig nach. Die verschiedenen Reiniger sind ebenso qualitativ hochwertig wie innovativ (säurefrei, umweltschonend) und kommen von einem Unternehmen, dessen Gründer mit Herzblut dabei sind, die Pakete mitunter selbst packen und verschicken und sich auf ihren Kanälen redlich Mühe geben eine möglichst persönliche und unmittelbare Kundenbetreuung zu bieten. Ich erwähne die Verlosungen bewusst zuletzt, weil ich auch ohne die Loschance auf einen sonst nur zu erträumende Fahrzeuge diese Produkte kaufen und weiterempfehlen würde. Dass man pro bezahltem Euro auf zuerst einen auf 333 Stück limitierten A1 Quattro, dann auf einen auf 999 Stück limitierten und getunten Audi R8 V10 RWD, dann auf ein Zweijahresleasing eines Golf 8GTI TCR und nun auf einen Porsche 991.1 GT3RS auf Lebenszeit mit Übernahme sämtlicher Kosten (außer Sprit) für ein Jahr erhält, ist die wohl saftigste Kirsche auf der Sahnehaube, die es gegenwärtig irgendwo gibt, und es unterstreicht für mich einfach mit jeder Live-Verlosung, mit wieviel Leidenschaft Viamontis dabei ist und, weswegen es sich immer lohnt aufstrebende Unternehmen für ihren Mut und Innovationsgeist zu unterstützen! Wer bis hier mitgelesen hat, der/dem danke ich für die Aufmerksamkeit, und wer diesen Beitrag nur überflogen hat, der/dem gebe ich mit: es gab nie bessere Gründe das eigene Zwei-,Drei- oder Vierrad zu pflegen, als mit den erstklassigen Produkten von Viamontis. Überzeugt euch selbst! I became aware of this company more than half a year ago via Instagram and ordered a few of their products on a trial basis, since then I regularly reorder. The various cleaners are as high quality as they are innovative (acid-free, environmentally friendly) and come from a company whose founders put their heart and soul into it, sometimes packing and shipping the packages themselves and making every effort to offer the most personal and direct customer service possible on their social channels. I deliberately mention the raffles last because I would buy and recommend these products even without the chance of winning a vehicle that I could otherwise only dream of. That they give one ticket per paid euro towards first winning a limited to 333 units A1 Quattro, then towards a limited to 999 units and tuned Audi R8 V10 RWD, then towards a two-year leasing of a Golf 8GTI TCR and now towards a Porsche 991. 1 GT3RS for life with all costs paid (except fuel) for one year is probably the juiciest cherry on top of the cream that is currently available anywhere, and for me it simply underlines with every raffle with how much passion Viamontis is involved and why it is always worth supporting up-and-coming companies for their courage and innovative spirit! For those of you who have been reading along up to this point, thank you for your attention, and for those of you who have only skimmed throughy this article, I can tell you that there have never been better reasons to maintain your own two, three or four-wheeler than with the first-class products from Viamontis. Treat yourselves!

(In manchen Fällen leider heutzutage gar nicht so einfach). Ebenso arbeiten wir laufend daran noch transparenter zu werden (obwohl wir da vermutlich eh schon Benchmark in diesem Bereich sind). review_text: I am writing this to warn other drivers, especially those in the Nuremberg/Erlangen area. I ordered 4 summer tires for my car and selected their "official" mounting partner, Ilka Automobile (Fuggerstr. 29, 90439 Nuremberg), during the checkout process. ​After the tires were dispatched, I personally drove to the address to coordinate the appointment, only to find a residential apartment building. There is no workshop, no signage, and no professional tire service at this location. It is a ghost address. ​When I contacted customer support, their response was shocking. They admitted they "no longer offer mounting stations" in that way, yet they still actively list them as verified partners on their website. Worse, they told me it was my responsibility to "personally contact" the workshop before ordering-even though their own system presents these shops as ready-to-use partners. ​The Reality: ​Misleading Information: They are taking money for a service (delivery to a partner) that does not exist. ​Poor Support: Instead of taking responsibility for their outdated database, they blamed me for not calling a "partner" they officially recommended. ​Logistical Nightmare: My expensive tires are now in transit to a residential building where they cannot be fitted, risking loss or theft. ​If you are in need of wheels that require professional mounting, avoid their partner list. They are misleading customers with a database that is clearly not maintained.

review_text: Ordered two winter tires on October 29th 2024, scheduled to arrive on November 5th. When they hadn't arrived on November 8th, I tried contacting them. The form on their website to check delivery status still said that the delivery would happen on the 5th (3 days ago lol). Tried contacting support through the contact form on their website, but couldn't submit the form because I didn't have a client ID (I ordered as guest). Ok then, let's call support! On hold for 1.5 hours until I get to speak to someone. This person told me my parcel is stuck at customs, and should be delivered by the end of the coming week. All good, I'm nothing if not patient. A week has passed, then 4 more days, no news, no updates, no tires. It's time to call support again, I guess. This time, I waited on the line for 2 hours, and the person who answered told me that the tires were stuck in an intermediate depot and the order somehow didn't get released from it. I now have two options: request a refund and cancel my order, or request a manager to analyze my delivery and hopefully release it. Sure, I say, let the manager take care of it, can't be that hard to get them released, right ? The following day I receive an email stating my order had been canceled, justification: "delivery time too long" and I haven't even been refunded. Now I'm once again on the phone, came in at number 37 in the call queue, got to number 1 after more than 4 hours of waiting, and finally gave up after 4.5 hours when no one was picking up the phone. In short: no tires, no refund, no support, and 8 hours of my life listening to the same 3 horrible tunes that I'm not getting back! I have never, EVER, had to do with such incompetent customer service. GET YOUR ACT TOGETHER 123pneus.ch! EDIT 26NOV2024: RD 53713018 EDIT 29NOV2024: Called the hotline again, as I still haven't gotten any news about my order or got the refund. This time I only had to wait one hour! The seemingly depressed agent at the phone told me that the order had been canceled (duh) and that I should have been refunded after two days (which of course I wasn't). I asked if they could just issue a new order with exactly the same products, but for some magical reason the tires that were available for my first order were not available anymore. I asked if I could speak to someone else, but the person said no, because they don't have phones in the other  building !? Honestly, if you can, ask your garage to order tires for you, or find any other place to order them. Going through this entire process is honestly not worth it when you got nothing to show for at the end. I would give less than one star if it was at all possible!

When I contacted customer support I at least expected them to contact the delivery company to confirm that my Parcel was on route and not lost. Edit The Parcel arrived Today the 14th of May. review_text: I bought on 01.11.2024. Everything was available in the lager at the time of the purchase so I thinking I had enough time for the tires arrive. I never been so wrong. After almost 4 weeks no sign of the tires and the rims. Really disappointed. This company took my money and ghost me. All the attempts of contacting them end in nothing, just silence, no one answer. The only answer I got was from a bot saying I would get a reply in 5min, but they never did. I bought from Reifendirekt in the past and never had any problems, but today I can’t recommend this company to anyone. I understand delays can happen, but I can’t understand is the lack of communication, I mean none. Until this date, never got a tracking number. Winter season already started and I’m sitting here without tires and money. So I already request a refund and I hope getting the money soon as possible for I can go buy tires to one of the many company’s out there that reply to their costumers. I hope I don’t need to take extra manners to get my money back. This as being stressful enough and looks like a nightmare. The only way I can update and give a better review it’s only if I get an reply in the next 24h saying my purchase is on the way with express delivery, but I know that’s not going to happen. Update: Communication still 0 but they refund my order. But I don’t advise order at this moment until they clarify what’s the issue with the delays and no communication. Update 2: Today I came from work and I found the order that I cancel and was refund already sitting on the street. Delivery company never contact me for a delivery and they just leave a cancel order on the street without a signature. I wouldn’t accept since I was refunded already and I bought the product from a local garage. I already contact Reifendirekt trough a formular to try arrange a return. I will storage the cancel order for 30days, if no delivery company come to pick up the order back, not my problem after. It’s kind sad because I could wait a bit longer if I had some clarification where the product was and when’s going be delivered. But the silence from the support team make all this happen. Hope Reifendirekt sort is problems specially with the delivery company. The tag on the order said were ship on 15.11.2024. They arrived 25 days later without announcement. But they need to work also on support team, they can’t just go silence. RD 53739314

review_text: I chose daekonline for new winter tires / alloys due to their excellent Trustpilot reputation (despite the items being cheaper on competing sites). As I had bought a new car on summer tires (and as it is winter time) time was of the essence. I therefore chose alloys and tires that daekonline.dk reported "in stock". After ordering I was immediately informed by mail that the order for the alloy had been sent to processing. Whereas I did not hear anything in regard to the tires (the alloys were no good to me alone – I need both alloys + tires and do not appreciate the order being split up in the first place). After 3 days I contacted daekonline.dk on telephone. I was told that, despite the tires still showing online as being “in stock” this was not the case. No guarantees could be made as to when these supposed in-stock tires would actually be shipped. On the other hand, I was assured that the alloys were in stock and were being processed for shipping. As I was in a hurry I cancelled the tire-part of the order and kept the alloy-part. I ordered the tires at a competing dealer that shipped the items immediately. 6 days later – while now having received the tires from the competing dealer I had still not received a track and trace for the alloys. I made contact by telephone again. Now daekonline.dk could inform me that the alloys were not in stock either. Despite still showing in stock on their site, despite being reassured about the very fact days earlier on phone. Frustrated I cancelled the remaining alloy-part of the order, telling myself never to deal with daekonline.dk again. To make matters worse, after having received a confirmed cancellation on the alloys on mail I received a new mail from daekonline.dk days later again. Despite cancellation the item had been shipped. They now demanded that the shop that I had contracted to do work refused to receive the cancelled order that should never have been shipped in the first place. As of writing daekonline.dk has still not released the reserved amount on my account. Despite both order-lines being cancelled. I cannot stress strongly enough, never to deal with daekonline.dk Jens Andersen on behalf of Ida Bojesen

Der er allerede sendt en anmodning om at få reservationen slettet på din konto, kontakt venligst din bank. Vi håber du kan acceptere vores undskyldning for ulejligheden og at denne uheldige situation ikke vil forhindre dig i at gøre samarbejde med os igen i fremtiden, og at på denne måde, vil du give os mulighed for at forbedre din mening om vores virksomhed. Daekonline.dk teamet
