When I asked the rather unfriendly support lady, if we could reach an agreement where I paid the original price + freight, as I found the increase unfair (and the tires are available at other online dealers, such as daekleader for 517 DKK including freight!), she bluntly said no. And I had no luck in getting her to help me. Instead, she referred to customer complaints. Very poor service! I am very disappointed and sorry to say that I am not going back to daekonline.dk until they 1) Improve the customer support and 2) give their customers a fair treatment. With all due respect.

Our products have a warranty period of 24 months from the delivery date. First, you should contact our customer service at daekonline@delti.com or by phone on (+45) 77345733. We hope this unfortunate situation will not prevent you from doing business with us again in the future and that this way, you will give us the opportunity to improve your opinion about our company. The Daekonline.dk team

review_text: I am very disappointed with my recent experience with Autodoc.I placed an order for Pirelli tires on 27.02.2026 and received them on 11.03.2026. This means the tires were already over 3 years old at the time of delivery, which is not what I expect when purchasing a “new” product in 2026.Since then, I have been dealing with this issue for almost a month. During this time, I have not been able to complete a necessary tire change, which has affected my ability to use my vehicle safely.In addition, I have had to store, move, and handle four tires multiple times due to this situation, which caused unnecessary physical effort and inconvenience — all because of incorrect or misleading expectations regarding the product.The most frustrating part is the lack of a satisfactory solution. I requested a reasonable compensation, considering the age of the tires and the inconvenience caused. Instead, I received only a minimal offer and repeated delays.I am based in Switzerland, and returning the tires is not simple or cost-effective. Despite this, I was informed that I may need to handle the return logistics myself, which I find unacceptable given that the issue is not caused by me.For a company of this size, I expected a much more customer-oriented approach and a fair resolution.If this matter is not resolved properly, I will consider taking further steps through consumer protection channels.I sincerely hope Autodoc will take this complaint seriously and provide a fair and reasonable solution.

review_text: After posting this complaint, I was eventually contacted and reimbursed for the incompatible parts. However, after a few messages, the employee who had initially reached out to me appeared to stop responding, which forced me to contact the in-app support again. Only then was a warranty claim filed and my money refunded. While I am grateful for the resolution, I remain concerned about the way it was handled.The company referred to this outcome as a ‘gesture of goodwill.’ In reality, complying with consumer protection law is not goodwill—it is a legal obligation. What troubles me most is that, instead of straightforward assistance, I personally had to spend a great deal of time researching laws, studying specific legal articles, and presenting them to prove that I had the right to a refund.I appreciate the final resolution, but the process was unnecessarily time-consuming, frustrating, and placed the entire burden on me as the customer.Order number: 119912765Order date: 10.09.2024I am extremely disappointed with Autodoc’s customer service and their refusal to take responsibility for an incorrect part selection.All my previous orders for my Honda Accord 8 (VIN: JHMCU35809C203590) were always placed through Autodoc’s support team, never by myself. I always relied on their staff to provide the correct parts. However, in this case Autodoc now falsely claims that I ordered the parts on my own without their involvement, which is absolutely not true.The lower control arms that I received do not fit my vehicle. This is a clear case of “Sachmangel” under §434 BGB (German Civil Code) — the goods do not conform to the contract, as they are not suitable for the intended purpose. According to §439 BGB, in such cases the seller is obliged to provide a correct replacement or a full refund, and also to compensate the customer for costs of removal/installation.Instead, Autodoc is trying to hide behind a 14-day return period, which is irrelevant here. The 14-day return policy only applies to voluntary returns. When the goods are not as described or do not match the contract due to the seller’s mistake, the time limit does not apply — this is confirmed by EU consumer law (Directive 1999/44/EC and Directive (EU) 2019/771 on consumer sales and guarantees).In other words:•	The parts were selected incorrectly by Autodoc staff (as in all my previous orders).•	The parts do not fit — this is legally a non-conforming good.•	Autodoc must provide a replacement or refund under BGB §§434–439 and EU Directive 2019/771.•	Refusing support and shifting blame onto the customer is a breach of EU consumer rights.I am now forced to escalate this case to the European Consumer Centre (ECC-Net) and file a formal complaint. This whole experience has shown me that Autodoc’s customer support is unwilling to take responsibility when their own mistake causes problems for the buyer.⚠️ Buyers beware: if Autodoc makes a mistake in selecting your parts, they will try to deny responsibility and hide behind irrelevant “return policies.”
supplier_response: Hello Александр Пятковский! We regret you faced all the inconvenience. Our Quality Control Manager will be contacting you shortly to review your case and assist you further. Best regards, AUTODOC Team

review_text: I’m pretty sure that this review makes no difference to ATP or my case, but hopefully people will think twice before buying anything from this company.I purchased a Sachs clutch kit from ATP, for my Audi A4. The payment and delivery went fine and quick, which is probably the only positive thing I have to say about this company.We had scheduled a repair at a local mechanic for a gearbox and clutch replacement, so we delivered the ATP clutch as per agreement to the mechanic. However, when the mechanic went to fit the new clutch to the car, he noticed that the clutch didn’t fit and was actually a LUK clutch (completely different brand to Sachs). The clutch was branded LUK on one side and Sachs on the other.As the car was taking up space on a lift and the mechanic couldn’t wait for a new clutch to be delivered, we had to buy the correct clutch locally. Unfortunately it didn’t come with a clutch release bearing, so we had to use the one supplied with the clutch kit from ATP.I called ATP and explained the situation (in German, as apparently only one or two ATP employees speaks English) and asked if it was possible for me to return the incorrect clutch without the bearing, to which they replied yes.I returned the clutch as agreed, and for a long period of time I heard nothing from them, so I decided to call them to see if they received the clutch. After a couple of calls, they informed me that they had in fact received the clutch, but that the bearing was missing and that they could not refund me as the set was not complete. I tried to explain the situation several times with no luck and no sympathy.ATP sells the exact clutch release bearing on their website and I informed them, that I would happily pay for the bearing that I had used from the kit, so they could replace it in the kit. But for some reason this is impossible to do for ATP. In theory I could just get the clutch back, buy the bearing, put it in the box and return a complete set.I have now spent several hours on the phone, trying to first of all get through to them on the phone, which is a nightmare. And when I finally manage to get through, nobody speaks English (fortunately I speak a little German). The employees that answer the phone cannot make any decisions and needs to speak to their supervisors and promises to call back, which they NEVER do, so you have to start all over every time you get through to them.To make things even better, now ATP wants me to pay them to return the wrong clutch to me.

review_text: "no risk 90 day money back guarantee". Yeah sure.Bought a Chinese made A/C compressor for my Mercedes from them. It leaked badly. Not because it was broken or something. The design was bad and impossible to  create a sealed system.Sent the unit back. They made every single excuse you could imagine- I hadn't given them a chance to fix the problem, so no warranty (I did  they answered no questions about making the product actually work).- I didn't include the original mechanic's invoice - (I did, right on top of the compressor)- They inspected the thing and claimed  there was no proof of the defect occuring before the installation (simply, the replacement part was of a bad design - didn't work before, didn't work after, despite trying many things to prevent having to pay to uninstall and then install a different one)- The invoice didn't show what they needed to see - no warranty (my Italian speaking mechanic hardly understands what I ask him in english, however, I made sure he did the job right - flushing, replacing the drying unit, etc.)In short, they kept the part (probably re-sold it) and kept the money also!Edited October 25, 2018: ATP tried hard to remove this review about a year ago. Fortunately, after trustpilot looked at the evidence, this review remained. Don't be fooled by the feeble bluff of an offer to resolve the issue more than two years after the fact. Do yourself a favour and listen to my and all others' experience in buying cheap, poorly made non-functional parts and purchase your car parts from a reputable source. Otherwise, we told you so. My mistake cost me 179 euros for the compressor plus nearly 300 euros extra for my mechanic's huge efforts to try to make the thing work and then remove it and replace it with a unit from Mercedes.

review_text: This review is for the company Autodoc or autoteiledirekt.de (they seem to operate under a bunch of different names, so I posted here and on Autodoc reviews).The short version: Absolutely terrible customer service, bordering on a scam. Order somewhere else!The very long one for those who care:I ordered a bunch of parts from them and to be fair the items are what I expected and do their jobs but 2 days after the items were supposed to be at my house (shipped inside Germany so no excuse there) I called them up and after pretty unfriendly interaction with their customer service guy I got promised that it would go out that day. So, if it says 2 days, expect a week.While I was talking to him I noticed the parts where now 30 Euros cheaper on a 200 Euro order and I asked him for a deal. I would have taken store credit, even a complimentary sponge or a packet of gummy bears or something that showed any interest in their customers, but he wasn't willing to budge. Fair enough there too, they don't have to.So, I told him I would just order the stuff again and return the first package and since they already delivered the parts too late for me I had all the time in the world (second package was late by the same time frame too). I even bought their safe order (sicher bestellen) feature on the first order, which states that I can return the uninstalled parts for a full refund for any reason within a 100 days or something like that. Since the boxes are just sitting here and haven’t even been opened it shouldn't have been a problem.A week after I filed for the return I haven't even gotten a mail saying that it is being processed other than their automated instant reply so I called them up again. I didn’t even get an answer the first 4 times I called even though it kept telling me constantly I was next in line. After 15 Minutes and 27 Seconds you get dropped from the line each time so you get to try again. I have a headset and plenty of time while i was doing other things so I just kept calling. Even tried calling them from 3 lines at once (I got bored) and you get the same message on all of them. That was around 10am on a regular business day. Never got through to anyone then so I tried again in the afternoon and after the second round of waiting I actually got someone who couldn't even say hello or good bye or anything and I tried my best to be extra friendly. I got some results in the form of six emails (one for each part I ordered) saying my return was accepted and an attached PDF Return Form for every part. Seemed like progress but it also said that my return mailers would come in separate emails which still haven't arrived 5 days later.I guess I will listening to some more annoying music and automated messages next week. At this point I fully expect them to either not answer at all or at best be extremely rude again. Chances of me getting the full refund, that their extra safe order service promises are slim to none and I bet they will give me the full runaround for that too.Calling it what it is at this point is a Scam.I will change this review accordingly if they manage to surprise me and not do any of that, after all terrible service and late deliveries aren't a scam if the parts are what you bought but at this point it sure looks like a Scam when it comes to their return policies and safe order options.Update (26.06.2018):I guess complaining loudly on the internet does help since their english speaking customer service called me up first thing monday and sent me the return mailer (just one though even though I got two boxes but since they already had all the heavy stuff in one box and the 2 super light things in a seperate one I figured they might as well go in a single box. Didn't want to argue over this but I took a bunch of pictures anyway). The english speaking customer service rep was very nice, which was a welcome change so I guess I'll be carefully optimistic and wait.Update (09.07.2018):Turns out they actually did send me three labels - in yet again three separate emails - just two ended up in spam. I guess since it took 40something emails (not even kidding) to get to this point. So I sent the three packages in the same arrangement they came here and apparently they received them on Jul. 2nd. Still waiting to hear anything further. Don't hold your breath on getting your money in any sort of timely fashion back. Mind you I started the Process over a month ago on June 3rd. I do realize the return proves and banks and all that take their sweet time too. I don't have a problem with that, but this is just ridiculous. How does a company with that terrible of a customer service stay in business these days? I've head better customer service from Indian tech support scammers than these guys. I’m curious what happens next. My guess is I do get some money back at some point or another but not even close to the amount I paid with all kinds of bogus charges and “service” fees as a justification. I guess we will see.

review_text: El mes de noviembre 2022 he comprado a través de eBay un catalizador para un Mini Cooper S cual me ha llegado con defectos en las roscas de los sensores y las chapas de sujeción también,cosa que he reclamado y me han devuelto 20€ de un total de 201€ ... hoy mes de octubre 2023( 11 meses más tarde )tenía que pasar la inspección técnica del vehículo y me han puesto falta grave por los gases porque el catalizador ya no hace bien su función.. según la garantía que dan por el catalizador la tienda BANDEL AUTOMOTIVE me deberían de devolver la cantidad entera de la pieza más la mano de obra de montaje cosa que yo no lo he reclamado y me he puesto en contacto con ellos a través de eBay por donde he realizado la compra y les he enviando foto del resultado de gases de la ITV pero ellos me dicen que la pieza ya no tiene garantía....parece que muchas tiendas online de Alemania están siguiendo los pasos de China tanto en calidad como la forma de los tratos con los clientes .... MUCHO CUIDADO CON ESTA EMPRESA 👎👎👎👎👎👎👎👎👎👎👎👎👎👎👎👎...yo seguiré dejando este mismo comentario en todas las páginas que aparecen en la web además les voy a reclamar a través de la OCU y por lo menos recuperar el dinero del catalizadorIn November 2022, I purchased a catalytic converter for a Mini Cooper S through eBay, which arrived with defects in the threads of the sensors and the fastening plates as well, which I complained about and they refunded me €20 of the total. of €201... today October 2023 (11 months later) I had to pass the technical inspection of the vehicle and they gave me a serious fault for the gases because the catalyst no longer does its job well... according to the guarantee they give For the catalyst, the BANDEL AUTOMOTIVE store should refund me the entire amount of the part plus the assembly labor, which I have not claimed and I have contacted them through eBay where I made the purchase and I have sent them a photo of the MOT gas result but they tell me that the part no longer has a warranty....it seems that many online stores in Germany are following in China's footsteps both in quality and in the way they deal with them. clients.... BE VERY CAREFUL WITH THIS COMPANY 👎👎👎👎👎👎👎👎👎👎👎👎👎👎👎👎... I will continue leaving this same comment on all the pages that appear on the website and I will also complain to them through the OCU and at least recover the money from the catalyst

review_text: Unfortunately, I cannot recommend dackonline.se based on my experience.I ordered a complete set of winter wheels on November 9th, with a promised delivery time of a maximum of 14 working days. This deadline passed by several weeks without me receiving any clear explanation. During this period, I was given conflicting information every time I called customer service – sometimes they claimed the tires couldn’t be delivered and tried to get me to cancel the order, while other times they promised that the wheels would be shipped “this week or next week.” None of it was true.At the same time, the exact same wheel package continued to be shown as “available” on their website, which felt both misleading and unprofessional.The customer service by phone cannot make any decisions at all; they only act as intermediaries and constantly refer to “the other department” that responds by email. This creates a Catch-22 situation – the phone support can’t help, and the email support doesn’t reply in time.Now they have also informed me that the product I ordered is sold out, despite it being listed as available during my entire waiting period. I have been forced to try to solve the issue myself, contact the Consumer Agency, and argue for an alternative, even though the fault lies entirely with them.It is extremely frustrating as a customer to have to chase answers, be transferred around, and receive different information with every contact. Especially when winter tires are legally required in Sweden and you depend on receiving your delivery on time.I recommend buying from a more reliable supplier that can actually keep their delivery times and provide consistent information to their customers.

Tried contacting support through the contact form on their website, but couldn't submit the form because I didn't have a client ID (I ordered as guest). Ok then, let's call support! On hold for 1.5 hours until I get to speak to someone. This person told me my parcel is stuck at customs, and should be delivered by the end of the coming week. All good, I'm nothing if not patient.A week has passed, then 4 more days, no news, no updates, no tires. It's time to call support again, I guess. This time, I waited on the line for 2 hours, and the person who answered told me that the tires were stuck in an intermediate depot and the order somehow didn't get released from it. I now have two options: request a refund and cancel my order, or request a manager to analyze my delivery and hopefully release it. Sure, I say, let the manager take care of it, can't be that hard to get them released, right ?The following day I receive an email stating my order had been canceled, justification: "delivery time too long" and I haven't even been refunded.Now I'm once again on the phone, came in at number 37 in the call queue, got to number 1 after more than 4 hours of waiting, and finally gave up after 4.5 hours when no one was picking up the phone.In short: no tires, no refund, no support, and 8 hours of my life listening to the same 3 horrible tunes that I'm not getting back!I have never, EVER, had to do with such incompetent customer service. GET YOUR ACT TOGETHER 123pneus.ch!EDIT 26NOV2024: RD 53713018EDIT 29NOV2024: Called the hotline again, as I still haven't gotten any news about my order or got the refund. This time I only had to wait one hour! The seemingly depressed agent at the phone told me that the order had been canceled (duh) and that I should have been refunded after two days (which of course I wasn't). I asked if they could just issue a new order with exactly the same products, but for some magical reason the tires that were available for my first order were not available anymore. I asked if I could speak to someone else, but the person said no, because they don't have phones in the other  building !? Honestly, if you can, ask your garage to order tires for you, or find any other place to order them. Going through this entire process is honestly not worth it when you got nothing to show for at the end. I would give less than one star if it was at all possible!

review_text: One of my old tires were leaking air, the tyres were near end of life so instead of trying to repair it I decided to order 4 new tyres.The tyres arrived at the installation partner and where installed on the car. I returned to the installation partner, and they could now tell me that the problem was the rim, not the tyre, and that I should by a new rim.I went  back online and bought a new rim according to the car model by following the guide on the webside. The rim arrived at the partner and they put on the tyre. Then when they tried to put it on the car, it turns out that it does not fit although it has all the right dimensions. They advise me to contact dekkonline.com.I contact dekkonline and they tell me that they will not take back a rim after it has been tried to put on the car!!! My question to them is then how would you know that it does not fit until you put it on the car, as long as I have ordered according to their process? It is my problem that the product I have ordered does not fit the car!!! And they suggest that I order a new rim at my own expense.
